blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tribunals ensure speedy justice delivery compared to traditional judicial procedures.
Decisions are made by specialized experts in relevant technical or legal fields.
They provide a cost-effective medium for resolving disputes.
A main objective of tribunals is to reduce the overwhelming case load on regular courts.
Tribunals are frequently tested regarding their role in relieving the heavy backlog of cases in traditional civil courts.
Questions often emphasize that expert decision-making differentiates tribunals from ordinary courts where judges may be generalists.
Speedy and cost-effective justice are key statutory rationale for establishing administrative and technical tribunals.
